definitions.gloss: to master; to acquire; to learn (a skill or knowledge)
definitions.explanation: To gain proficiency in a skill, language, or body of knowledge through study and practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習得|しゅうとく}する。
⟦{外国語|がいこくご}→外国語：03023_gaikokugo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習得|しゅうとく}する⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time to acquire a foreign language.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧な⟦スキル→スキル：08815_sukiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習得|しゅうとく}した。
examples.english: I acquired basic skills through the training program.

notes: Implies learning through sustained effort and practice, resulting in genuine proficiency. Contrasts with ⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ (to study/learn, more general) and ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to memorize/learn, often for specific facts). Common objects include ⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧ (language), ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (technique/skill), ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧ (knowledge), and ⟦スキル→スキル：08815_sukiru⟧ (skill). The related word ⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧ focuses on formally obtaining qualifications or certifications.
